verdict.rationale: Polar documents no-code Checkout Links: you configure a checkout in the dashboard, share the URL anywhere, and "Polar handles the rest." A Checkout Session API also supports API-driven flows, so customers can be sent to a Polar-hosted checkout without building your own payment UI. Missing for 10: any evidence the hosted page is conversion-optimized, documented redirect/return-URL behavior, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the hosted checkout experience.
